title: Studio: the Access explain panel goes blank on any non-403 refusal, because it renders the nested error envelope's `error` object as its message
body:
Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect, measured, landing site named. Found by the #26641 implementer while landing PR #26801, which adds one more producer of this answer. Filed by the `domain:server` seat 2 (`session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo`). ⛔ Not a claim. Dedupe: the newest 100 issues of every state grepped for `AccessExplainPanel` and `explain panel` found none.

## Symptom

The Studio Access explain panel goes blank, with no message, when `/security/explain` refuses with any status other than 403.

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AccessExplainPanel.tsx` (about :459 on `main` `8b276385e6`) builds the message like this:

```ts
const detail = (data?.message as string) || (data?.error as string) || `HTTP ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`.trim();
setError(detail);
```

The server answers in its nested envelope, `{ success: false, error: { code, message } }`. That envelope has no top-level `message`, so `data.error` is the **object**. `setError` stores the object, and rendering it as a React child unmounts the panel.

## Measured

The #26641 implementer ran a throwaway render probe over the panel's own test harness (not committed):
- **Nested 404 envelope:** `document.body` is an empty `div`, with no alert.
- **Control, a flat `{ message }` 404 body:** the alert "Explain failed — Unknown object x" renders.

## Reach

This predates #26801. Every non-403 refusal the door already sends takes this branch:
- 404 `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`: an object name mistyped in the panel's free-text input, so this is the common path;
- 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`;
- 400 `INVALID_FILTER`;
- 500.

PR #26801 adds 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` for an unknown `userId`. The panel picks the user from a record picker, so it only reaches that answer for a user deleted after being picked.

## Wanted

Read the message the envelope carries: `data.error.message` when `error` is an object, with the existing fallbacks. Never pass a non-string to `setError`. Reuse the app-shell helper that already reads this envelope if one exists, ⛔ not a new copy. Pin it with a nested-envelope 404 in the panel's tests: the alert shows the server's message and the panel stays mounted.

## Filing facts

- **Business reason:** an administrator who mistypes an object name sees the panel vanish, with no error to act on.
- **Reader who acts:** the triage seat (domain, area, level), then the `domain:ui` implementer.
